name: GroundRules
tagline: The original text of US federal and state law, with its source and date
description: A free remote MCP server for US law. Give it an address and it names the governments that make law there; search the US Code, the CFR and the statutes of all 50 states, DC and Guam by topic or citation; read a section word for word with its official source, current-through date and a stale flag when the publisher has moved on. It never summarizes or interprets the law and is not legal advice. No account or API key.
